newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich Insurance adopts new strategy.
newsitem.headline: Zurich Insurance adopts new strategy.

text.p: Zurich Insurance said it is adopting a new global market and branding strategy, encompassing a new corporate identity, and is changing its focus, making asset management its new core business.
It will also drop Insurance from its mark.
"Zurich has moved beyond being an insurance company to being a global financial services entreprise," the company said in a statement.
Zurich said it intended to implement the new strategy in carefully planned stages.

Central to the new strategy was the objective of providing integrated customer solutions for financial protection as well as the professional management of financial assets and investments from a single source.
The strategy relies on a market segmentation approach whereby customer groups with similar needs will be served by independent strategic business units.
The company also said it was strengthening its capabilities in the area of investment and asset management and further expanding its range of services. -- Zurich Editorial +41 631 7340
